items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: He was also in New York about the same time I did, when we both wound up in New York later on.

ctx.x: But I think that Floyd and Steve and myself are the only ones I can recall who, from Tuskegee, who did make it. Who stayed with it. Of course, from Alabama State, where I had some elementary school training, Erskin Hawkins became very famous.
Oh yeah; was he at Alabama State?
